# Don't rent intelligence.  Own it.

![Odyn Powered by Aviso](https://framerusercontent.com/images/EXgAKd9IbjDPzk6mE2OdCwG742Q.png?width=1200&height=834)

Meet Odyn

Powered by

Odyn connects to your apps, reasons across your live business context, answers your queries, and takes next best actions based on models that are fine-tuned for you and yours to keep.

Book A Demo

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/q92sWL4zLc0NOSCYkqDzFIiHenY.png?width=1992&height=1234)

The Problem

## The Enterprise Knowledge Crisis

Knowledge workers spend roughly one day a week hunting for answers that should be instant. Critical context is buried across 10+ systems with no single source of truth. Every blind spot is a real dollar cost.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/Zpz0IeCNd2QkOQq66bdCKSgckM.png?width=2048&height=1500)

The Odyn Platform

## Everything it takes to go from question to outcome

Context-Aware Decision Engine

### Search that returns decisions, not links

Cross-system answers grounded in your live business state, with the next action ready to execute.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/DsnGtTTXb2BA2TEKDZx5h9x9Jw.png?width=2048&height=1500)

**Decisions, not summaries**Odyn returns the specific answer and the next best action, not a list of links to sort through.

**Hallucination control by architecture**Every answer is grounded in your business logic and verified against source data before it's delivered.

**Consistent answers**Context Graph-aware reasoning means the same question gets the same reliable answer, every time.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/I0pMtRjiiINDwRnQtdRvxLCQe0.png?width=2048&height=1500)

From Insight to Action

### From answers to executed outcomes

Odyn doesn't stop at insight, it finishes the task.

**Multi-path reasoning** Odyn evaluates several data paths at once to land on the most accurate answer.

**Automated executive reporting**

Odyn generates recurring reports directly from live data, zero manual prep.

**Live intelligence, not delayed indexing**

Odyn reasons over the real-time state of your business, never a stale index.

Adaptive Multi-Agent Execution

### Coordinated workflows that never break

Shared memory, coordinated execution, and work that doesn't fall through the gaps.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/I4CJmkxfP498NabAazlTaXALHLM.png?width=2048&height=1500)

**Shared memory across agents** Every agent works from the same real-time business state, so no context is lost between steps.

**Dynamic re-planning** When something changes - an SLA breach, a policy update - Odyn re-routes automatically.

**Self-correcting** If an agent hits a dead end, Odyn detects it and adjusts, without waiting on a human.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/ujFOLEqsMmucTsFdxAsT71DWgM.png?width=2048&height=1500)

No-Code Agent Builder

### Build custom agents with no code

Describe the outcome in plain language. The agent builds itself.

**130+ ready-made agents** Across Engineering, IT Ops, HR, Legal, Sales, and Marketing - install and go.

**Production-ready in hours** Describe your business logic in natural language - no engineering dependency.

**Scale without losing governance** Every agent deploys with built-in approvals, access controls, and audit logs.

The Context Graph

### We don't index documents. We model your business.

Every person, deal, ticket, contract, and metric becomes a living, connected node so every answer Odyn gives is grounded in what's actually true right now, not a stale search index.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/uyQBcU0I59DV3a5WnIfSai43Trs.png?width=2048&height=1500)

How Odyn Works

## From signal to finished work, automatically

Four simple steps happen behind every answer and every action Odyn takes.

# 01

### Sense

Odyn notices the moment something changes - a ticket opens, a deal stalls, a metric moves.

# 02

### Reason

It connects the dots across every tool, grounded in your Context Graph, so the answer is never a guess.

# 03

### Decide

It knows what can move on its own and what needs a human. Routine work runs automatically, the rest waits for your approval.

# 04

### Act

It finishes the job, drafts the email, files the ticket, updates the CRM, so the work is actually done.

Own It, Don't Rent It

## Most "AI search" tools are a wrapper around someone else's model.

Odyn is different: the model is fine-tuned on your data, hosted in your boundary, and yours to keep.

What matters

Typical AI Search Tools

Odyn

Where your data goes

Every query passes through a third-party LLM provider

Stays inside your boundary, no third-party LLM in the path

Who owns the learning

The vendor’s model improves; you don’t keep it

Your fine-tune is your asset, take it with you

What you get back

A link. You still do the work.

A cited answer, plus a finished action

How it’s priced

Per seat + per query, with the model provider’s markup baked in

Outcome-based, no per-token vendor tax

**Security & Sovereignty**

## Open Weights · Closed Boundary.

Your data never leaves your boundary. Ever.

NO 3RD-PARTY LLM

### **Your data stays yours**

Inference runs on open-weight models in your VPC or a dedicated tenant. The data path stops at your firewall.

CERTIFICATIONS

### **Independently audited**

SOC 2 Type II · ISO 27001 · HIPAA · GDPR · CCPA, with annual penetration testing.

PERMISSIONS

### **See only what you can see**

Source-system permissions are enforced at retrieval, synced in real time.

GOVERNANCE

### **Approval built in**

Low-risk actions run automatically; anything higher-risk requires sign-off, with a full audit trail.
